title: Integrate complete static path into processBlock
description:
Compose the complete static audio path in Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp, and register the new Source/DSP sources in CMakeLists.txt. This is the phase's single serialized CMakeLists.txt source-registration write.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h (topologies, mixing, bypass surface from f.1 and f.4)
- Source/DSP/FeedbackController.h (cross-feedback surface from f.2)
- Source/DSP/SafetyProcessor.h (safety surface from f.3)
- Source/DSP/DelayVoice.h (Hold surface from f.5)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h and .cpp (existing prepareToPlay, isBusesLayoutSupported, processBlock, member ownership)
- CMakeLists.txt (existing target_sources list for the plugin target)

Required processBlock composition, in this order:
1. juce::ScopedNoDenormals at the very top of processBlock.
2. Input gain g = 10^(G_dB/20), with the dB value smoothed over 20 ms in dB and converted to linear only afterward.
3. Preserve the dry path in a buffer allocated in prepareToPlay.
4. Per-block HostTiming acquisition (playhead read once per block, not per sample).
5. Process both DelayVoices, honouring RoutingEngine::delayInputGain() for trails bypass.
6. RoutingEngine (topology, normalization, cascade, bypass).
7. StereoProcessor.
8. SafetyProcessor (mandatory layer plus optional limiter; apply the ceiling to the requested feedback gain and honour the consumable buffer-clear request at a bounded block boundary).
9. Global mix (Insert or Send).
10. Output gain, smoothed 20 ms in dB.

Bus layout requirements: mono-mono, mono-stereo, and stereo-stereo must be supported by isBusesLayoutSupported. Mono dry input remains center-equivalent in stereo; width is created only in the wet path; unused output channels are initialized deterministically (explicitly zeroed or explicitly filled), never left with stale contents.

Allocation: every maximum-size buffer, including the dry copy and per-voice staging buffers, is allocated in prepareToPlay. processBlock performs no heap allocation, locks, file IO, profile parsing, string construction, GUI calls, unbounded loops, buffer resizing, FFT allocation, coefficient-object allocation, or destruction of heap-owned objects.

CMakeLists.txt: add Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.cpp and Source/DSP/SafetyProcessor.cpp (and any other new .cpp introduced in this phase) to the existing plugin target_sources list. Do not add test file registrations here; tasks f.7, f.8, and f.9 own those, each serialized after this one. Do not add any third-party dependency, FetchContent call, or find_package for a new library.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.cpp processBlock applies input gain as 10^(G_dB/20) from a dB-domain smoothed value, then dry capture, HostTiming, both DelayVoices, RoutingEngine, StereoProcessor, SafetyProcessor, global mix, and output gain in that order
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp scales delay voice input by RoutingEngine::delayInputGain so trails bypass stops new delay input
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp honours the SafetyProcessor buffer-clear request at a block boundary rather than clearing large buffers mid-block
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp isBusesLayoutSupported accepts mono-mono, mono-stereo, and stereo-stereo and rejects other layouts
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp deterministically initializes unused output channels and keeps mono dry input center-equivalent in stereo
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp allocates all working buffers in prepareToPlay and processBlock contains no new/delete, malloc, buffer resize, juce::String construction, lock acquisition, or GUI calls
CMakeLists.txt lists Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.cpp and Source/DSP/SafetyProcessor.cpp in the plugin target sources and adds no new third-party dependency
cmake --build build --target ShredSpace_VST3 ShredSpace_LV2 ShredSpace_Standalone -j 4 succeeds
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h, Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.cpp, Source/DSP/FeedbackController.h, Source/DSP/FeedbackController.cpp, Source/DSP/SafetyProcessor.h, Source/DSP/SafetyProcessor.cpp, Source/DSP/DelayVoice.h, or Source/DSP/DelayVoice.cpp
register test source files in CMakeLists.txt in this task
add FetchContent, find_package, or any new third-party dependency
change the JUCE submodule pin or plugin identity fields (name, vendor, version, manufacturer code, plugin code, bundle identifier, LV2 URI)
allocate memory, lock, parse profiles, or construct strings inside processBlock

allowed: choose member names and buffer layout for dry and per-voice staging buffers
choose how HostTiming is cached for the block
forbidden: change any DSP module public interface
introduce a new processing graph or framework
support bus layouts beyond mono-mono, mono-stereo, and stereo-stereo
